summary: Every identity and capability fact I checked holds against primary sources: vendor repo continuity (org isVerified=false), createdAt 2026-07-23, Apache-2.0 from metadata only with no LICENSE file, param and byte counts, all config values (10 full-attention + 30 GDN layers), context 262,144 with YaRN to 1,010,000, the text-only release requiring --language-model-only, the thinking and preserve_thinking template logic, the Qwen3-Coder XML tool format, and all seven benchmark values with their stated settings. The benchmarks are vendor in-house single runs. The contest is real: Qwen's own card reports 73.4 (SWE-bench Verified) and 49.5 (SWE-bench Pro) for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, where KAT's table re-ran it at 64.40 and 40.63. Discussion #11 shows Kwaipilot declined the community eval PR and asked to be removed from the HF ranking. Only one wording correction: speed_notes calls vLLM issue #51250 an 'HF discussion'. Gaps: the Ornith 75.6/50.4 numbers were checked only as quoted in discussion #12, not at Ornith's own card. llama.cpp chat.cpp and vLLM registry line numbers, the per-request llama.cpp/Ollama thinking toggles, and the checkpoint rows beyond four spot checks were not re-verified. Raw files are in $SCRATCH/kat/.
